status: Unit pack contracts specified; only existing test files are runnable before their owning tasks implement the planned files.

unitFrameworks.node: node:test + node:assert/strict with existing Node type stripping

unitRules: No network, sockets, real AI, database service, ADB, real clock sleeps or shared user files.
Inject boundaries; use temporary directories only for filesystem-unit behavior. Use frozen small synthetic fixtures and literal independent expected values.
All required case IDs must execute; zero discovered tests, missing cases, failed assertions or skipped required cases prevent success.
Case counts are behavior coverage, not a claim of exhaustive correctness or production readiness.

sharedFixtureContract.rule: Create only fixtures needed by implemented packs; label provenance and keep golden expectations independent of tested code.

exits.0: All selected required packs/cases executed and passed.
exits.1: Failure, invalid selection/report, zero-test suite or skipped/missing required discovered case.
exits.2: Incomplete because selected planned pack/tool is unavailable; report not_run, never pass.

runner.selectionRule: Use tracker.requiredUnitPacks for --task; --changed uses changeImpact rules and testFiles, subject to activationRule. Include existing baseline for affected app behavior. Unknown executable paths require an explicit owner/pack mapping before task completion.
runner.resultRule: Execute argument arrays without shell concatenation. Parse actual test results and case-name mappings; nonzero exit never becomes pass. --all reports every catalog pack including absent planned packs. R14 can summarize incomplete results without approving gates. Exit 1 takes precedence if failures and unavailable packs coexist. Include every failed/skipped/not_run required case, rather than only aggregate exit status.
runner.activationRule: For --task, required packs must be implemented and run. For --changed, also run impacted existing/implemented packs and packs owned by the current task. A future dependent pack whose creator has not run is deferred with not_run/deferred_owner, not a producer failure or pass. Its owner must execute it against current hashes before becoming done. --all includes every planned pack and returns incomplete when any is absent.
runner.freshnessRule: Whole manifest hash is provenance. Reuse compares consumed pack definitions, tests, source and fixture hashes, not unrelated later catalog entries.

changeImpact.note: Any changed executable assertions/state rules additionally select their owning runtime packs.

Source-behavior diagnostic is reproducible research, not a defect-fix acceptance suite. Future regression packs activate with their owning tasks. Native checks required only for relevant behavioral changes.

nonUnitChecks.scope: Real loopback HTTP with injected provider; extend boundary tests when service/AI contract changes.
Service/client and actual save/reopen/index adapter boundaries; record actual adapter mode.
Available entry checks only; full named-device journey/accessibility protocol remains required.
Authorized real-provider run; never part of offline unit success.

cases.given: confirmed profile plus edited draft
cases.then: Committed profile/revision unchanged; nested draft arrays cannot mutate original.

cases.given: valid confirmed edit and successful fake persistence
cases.then: Commit exactly once and advance revision once; invalidate derived results.

cases.given: invalid edit or rejected/failed persistence
cases.then: Preserve prior profile/revision; no saved/success acknowledgement.

cases.given: draft screen/weight filters applied then cancelled/cleared
cases.then: Cancel preserves active filters; clear restores eligible set without changing needs/budget.

cases.given: two selected exact IDs then third selection
cases.then: Keep max two distinct IDs and explicit rejection/removal behavior; no silent replacement.

cases.given: old request/revision result after a newer confirmation
cases.then: Ignore stale result; cancellation cannot commit a late proposal.

cases.given: saved old observations and newer catalog values
cases.then: Keep historical dates/prices and exact variant IDs; current values are separate.

cases.given: VM task removed or primary tasks reordered
cases.then: Maintain required tasks and hard budget; reset inapplicable clarification without inventing confirmation.

cases.given: Two actions captured the same committed store; the first write is delayed.
cases.when: Queue a theme update and a save, then complete both writes.
cases.then: Both acknowledged changes survive. Reduce each mutation against the latest committed state when dequeued; do not enqueue stale full-store snapshots.

cases.given: Initial storage read rejects, or corrupt current bytes coexist with an old recovery backup.
cases.when: Attempt a write before successful retry/recovery; request export.
cases.then: Block normal writes while storage readiness is unresolved. Export the exact current recoverable bytes, not an unrelated older backup; preserve old data on retry failure.

cases.given: A normal write is in flight when delete-all or reset is requested.
cases.when: Complete operations in both delayed-write orders.
cases.then: Delete/reset participates in the same coordinator or invalidates the earlier generation; no old decision reappears after acknowledgement or restart.

cases.given: Saved records contain negative amounts, invalid dates/versions, mismatched observation IDs or duplicate ordered uses.
cases.then: Reject/quarantine invalid records with recoverable originals and precise warnings; confirmed needs satisfy normal validation, observations reference the selected exact variants.

cases.given: Detail opened from Search or Compare; picker at step 2; filters have uncommitted edits.
cases.when: Close AI, press picker Back/close, or cancel filters through pure transition handlers.
cases.then: Return to the recorded origin and focused variant; step Back preserves draft, dismiss does not commit. Native modal dispatch/focus still require DEVICE evidence.

cases.given: Confirm or save receives repeated taps while the same action is pending.
cases.when: Resolve the write once, then issue a separate new action.
cases.then: One pending action produces one acknowledgement/revision/snapshot; independent saves receive collision-safe distinct IDs using injected ID/clock sources.

cases.given: Queued updater throws before writing
cases.when: Process it then enqueue a valid mutation
cases.then: Failed updater returns false; later valid write executes; no unhandled rejection or poisoned queue.

currentResearchChecks.purpose: Reproduce FLOW-01–FLOW-06 against hashed original source with injected dependencies. Successful assertions confirm flaws, not acceptance. Archive current results and migrate to desired-behavior regression tests during fixes; do not require defects to persist.
